notes.title: Patch Note #3 (Demo)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206049/5329f18c50b312af655654d72c84fc72e07bbb36.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Changed the order images. Now there's a lower chance of serving the wrong cocktail without ice. The ice icon is more noticeable. And the ingredient icons are bigger![/p][/*][*][p]Changed the logic for adding ingredients. You can no longer add the same ingredient more than once.[/p][/*][*][p]A green checkmark appears above the coffee machine, juicer, and shaker after something has been prepared in them.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting on the location.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance. A weak PC won't overheat as much as before.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated fonts. All fonts are now displayed correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mistakes in some languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animations for some objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added refill logic for throwing items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed images on tutorial levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed colliders on levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors with displaying hints in other languages during level loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly redesigned the level completion screen interface.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Note #2 (Demo)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206049/7ea915813e78e8a484c168489c4f9a1e919cbc36.png[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added detailed tutorials as separate levels. You can return to the tutorial at any time via the main menu if you forget something.
[*] Fixed spelling and punctuation in some languages.
[*] Improved the animation of order appearance.
[*] Enhanced the animation for successful order completion.
[*] Fixed incorrect dash functionality.
[*] Added cute kittens to the levels (try to find them :)).
[/list]

P.S. We are endlessly grateful for your comments and feedback.

With love,
Team8Studio team.

notes.title: Patch Note #1 (Demo Version)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206049/fc800bb518eae15fa7e8127f8a6fd655fdf44b08.png[/img][h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the collider in the warehouse (level 4).
[*] Fixed issues with changing sound and language in the main menu.
[*] Fixed issues with saves not working correctly.
[*] Now in the game settings, you can switch between tabs using CTRL and ALT.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of controls in the keyboard settings.
[*] Fixed the issue with switching in settings using the cursor.
[*] Changed the text in the initial and final cutscenes.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you so much for helping us improve![/h2]

P.S. We see your feedback. We are currently working on making the demo version playable with gamepads.

With love,
Team8Studio team.

notes.title: The demo is finally here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, The Barkeeper team is here. 
We'd like to announce that the demo version of the game is finally here.

We've got a lot of work to do. This demo is our vision of the game itself.
The game is marked as in Early Access. This means it can change by the time we complete it.
And you can help us with that. If you have any suggestions, thoughts, ideas, feel free to reach us via [url=https://discord.gg/qQwmnReZed]Discord [/url]or our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3113670]Steam Group[/url]. We'll be glad to hear from you.

With love.
Team8Studio.
